preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(interval, tuple) and len(interval) == 2 and isinstance(interval[0], int) and isinstance(interval[1], int) and interval[0] <= interval[1] for interval in intervals)
preconditions.description: Every element in the input list is a tuple of two integers where the first element is less than or equal to the second (valid interval).
The input list contains between 1 and 100 intervals.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= interval[0] <= interval[1] <= 1000 for interval in intervals)
preconditions.description: All interval start and end values are integers between 0 and 1000, inclusive, with start <= end.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(interval, tuple) and len(interval) == 2 and isinstance(interval[0], int) and isinstance(interval[1], int) and interval[0] <= interval[1] for interval in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every element in the output list is a valid interval (tuple of two integers with start <= end).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= interval[0] <= interval[1] <= 1000 for interval in return_value)
postconditions.description: All output interval values are integers between 0 and 1000, inclusive.
The output list contains no more intervals than the input list (merging reduces or preserves count).

postconditions.expression: all(intervals[i][0] <= return_value[j][0] <= return_value[j][1] <= intervals[i][1] for i in range(len(intervals)) for j in range(len(return_value)) if any(intervals[i][0] <= x <= intervals[i][1] for x in range(return_value[j][0], return_value[j][1] + 1)))
postconditions.description: Every output interval is a merged result of one or more overlapping or adjacent input intervals (coverage).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][1] < return_value[i+1][0] for i in range(len(return_value) - 1))
postconditions.description: Output intervals are non-overlapping and sorted in ascending order by start time.

postconditions.expression: not any(intervals[i][0] <= x <= intervals[i][1] for i in range(len(intervals)) for x in range(return_value[j][0], return_value[j][1] + 1) for j in range(len(return_value)) if return_value[j][0] > intervals[i][1] or return_value[j][1] < intervals[i][0])
postconditions.description: No output interval contains any point from an input interval that is not part of its merged group (no false merges).
